en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a tree‑lined dirt road beside a fenced industrial complex of brick buildings with ornate gables and a small tower. The caption at the top reads "Radeburg. Gaswerk", indicating a municipal gasworks. On the main front building, another inscription with a year is visible above the central window. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century German industrial facility.
